control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT is below 60, follow the line in the dark; otherwise call avoidWalls.
In dark line following: if the line tracker is below 90, curve left; else if above 95, curve right; otherwise call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70, turn away from a side obstacle if one is seen; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70, drive forward; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

uncertainties: The sentence doesn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do there.
The wall-avoiding turns only run when the left light is below 70 while the right light is 60 or more, which happens only at an angled tunnel opening.
The line tracker's in-between value from 90 to 95 exists only at an edge, so avoidWalls in the dark is not a stable situation.
On a plain bright floor the program curves right, and on a plain dark floor it curves left, so it needs a line to get anywhere.
The program never checks the front obstacle sensor in dim light, so it doesn't stop at a wall in the dark.
